timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel nervous about going to the gym.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I’m scared people will notice or judge me.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like I don’t belong there yet.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep imagining doing something wrong.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tense just thinking about walking in.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I compare myself to everyone else there.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to just stay home instead.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit how intimidating this feels.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This fear feels bigger than the workout itself.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can feel nervous and still walk in anyway.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Everyone there started as a beginner once.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to look a certain way to belong there.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Most people are focused on themselves, not me.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle a little, even with these nerves.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to not know what I’m doing yet.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can go at my own pace without comparing.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to take up space while I learn.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This gets easier every time I show up.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of walking in, even nervous.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to figure it out as I go.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to be a beginner here.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on myself and my own progress.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is capable of more than I give it credit for.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m building confidence one visit at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be proud of myself just for showing up.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to belong here as much as anyone else.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to walk in and start.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you begin.
